detailZones.title: Scanner housing and opening
detailZones.description: Follow the white housing down to the black curtain and the suitcase in its opening.

detailZones.title: Infeed conveyor lane
detailZones.description: Trace the flat black belt, the adjacent silver rollers and the black suitcase resting on them.

detailZones.title: Operator viewing stations
detailZones.description: Find the monitor on the left desk and follow its stand down to the keyboard, mouse and open shelf.

detailZones.title: Right-hand scanner and rollers
detailZones.description: Follow the smaller scanner from its silver hood to the ribbed rollers beneath the suitcase.

detailZones.title: Bins, trays and carry-on bags
detailZones.translation: 托盘、置物箱与随身行李
detailZones.description: Compare the visible blue and gray bins, return lane, trays, cart and plain carry-on bags.

detailZones.title: Service rails and room panels
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible screening-room floor, rails, partitions, service table, shelves, panels and seams.

anchorAudit.rationale: Locations were checked against the finished photograph, including the black monitor, foreground suitcase, silver roller bed and open desk shelf. Scanner modality, belt direction on the right, internal fittings and the absent desk drawer are available in the index.
